grammar.summary: 本课学习 while doing 时间状语与 signal 场景表达。

points.title: while + doing 分词状语
points.explanation: While flying over the mountains, the pilot saw... 省略主语+be（逻辑主语同主句），分词作时间状语。

examples.en: When it crashed, the plane was on fire.

points.title: so...that 复现与 order 表命令
points.explanation: The signal was so faint that... so...that 结果从句复现，叙事工具箱持续扩充。

examples.en: She stamped out the letters SOS in the snow.
